question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **massively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Massively** is used to refer to a very large and heavy or solid form.

 
 
• **Example -** *A **massively** built four-storey building.*
 
 
 
• ​Here in the given paragraph,** 'massively' is used as an adverb to describe the size of a Python snake.**
 
• It is qualifying the adjective** 'built'.**
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'massively'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *Python snake, also known as Ajgar, is one of the most **(1)** __**massively**__ built snakes of the Indian subcontinent. It belongs to the Boidae family and is (2)__________ on water to quite an extent. One of the (3)__________ features of the Rock pythons of India is that they can raise their body temperature above the ambient level (4) ________ muscular contractions. Rock python is a (5) ___________ creature, moving only while hunting or when threatened.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Heartily** is used in a cordial manner; with warmth and sincerity.
 
• **Generously** means a way that shows a willingness to give money, help, kindness, etc.
 
• **Boldly** means in a brave and confident way, without showing any fear.
